skills.name: Dokkasou (毒華爪)
skills.line: My Poison Claws will end you.
skills.description: Sesshoumaru uses his claws to to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK with a 100% base chance of decreasing their DEF by 20%, lasts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Barrier: Tenseiga! (天生牙結界)
skills.description:
When Sesshoumaru takes damage, Tenseiga will prevent 30% of damage being taken, up to a max of 40% of his lost HP.
;
:
;Invincible (無敵)
:Immune to damage, debuffs and control effects.
:''(A large barrier will appear around Sesshoumaru.)''
;Weakened After Resurrection (復活結界による衰弱)
:
:'''General, Mark''': Damage dealt is decreased by 40%.
;Statuses and Marks
:Includes buffs, debuffs and general effects.

skills.name: Meido Zangetsuha (冥道残月破)
skills.description:
Sesshoumaru uses Meido Zangetsuha to attack all enemies dealing damage equal to 150% of his ATK with a 100% base chance of inflicting them with Fractured Mark, lasts for 2 turns.
''(While Sesshoumaru is in his 2nd skin, this skill changes to Bakusaiga.)'' ;Fractured Mark (破裂の印) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Healing effects are reduced by 100% when HP is below 30%. Cannot be revived and revival effects cannot be triggered upon being KO'd.

skills.name: Bakusaiga (爆砕牙)
skills.description:
Sesshoumaru uses Bakusaiga to attack all enemies dealing damage equal to 150% of his ATK with a 100% base chance of inflicting them with Fractured Mark, lasts for 2 turns.
''(While Sesshoumaru is in his 1st or 3rd skin, this skill changes to Meido Zangetsuha.)'' ;Fractured Mark (破裂の印) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Healing effects are reduced by 100% when HP is below 30%. Cannot be revived and revival effects cannot be triggered upon being KO'd.
